subject: Friday: Plotting in Base R with Michael Koontz

messages.subject: Friday: Plotting in Base R with Michael Koontz
parts:
Hi all,

This Friday at D-RUG, Michael Koontz will give a talk on making high-quality plots using R’s base graphics system. From Michael:

Want to get started plotting in R? Want to make high quality plots for presentations, reports to your colleagues, or peer-reviewed papers? Fortunately, these goals don’t have to conflict, because “high quality” doesn’t necessarily mean “impossibly complicated.” On Friday, I’ll walk through an interactive R script with some basic plotting functionality and then I’ll show a few methods that I find myself frequently using to make successful plots using only base R graphics. Bring your laptop and work through the script with me to get the most out of the presentation!

​

We’ll screencast the talk live for those not on-campus at this link: http://goo.gl/ohWBOZ. Video, code and materials from the talk will be posted on the blog afterwards.

Per usual, the presentation + Q&A will run from 10-11 in Wickson 2124, and we will have open co-work time from 11-12.
